title: Four cumulative improvements to Dirichlet nonvanishing at 0.873945166
description: Four successive exact improvements were certified before starting Lean verification: 0.873945927, 0.873945654, 0.873945618, and 436972583/500000000 = 0.873945166. The final result uses 125 count-source steps with Lambda decrement 1/800 and 77 physical-source steps with decrement 1/400. A proved LOW-payment identity permits reserve 1/10000 instead of 1/1000; all other source and return gates are rechecked exactly. The count chain begins at tracker #86's final source; the physical chain begins at its boot source. The return height is 402563361/500000000. Total gain over tracker PR90 is 467/500000000. The all-moduli Dirichlet conclusion excludes the principal pole and retains the preprint's 7/8 theorem and inherited analytic machinery. Required wider-density lemmas are included under separate namespaces, with no pending PR dependency. Builds on OpenAI, Hailey Collet, Sil, ArviFoxy, Jacob Sussman, Rohan Arun and tracker PRs 89/90. Research, certificate generation and formalization were substantially AI-assisted by OpenAI Codex. Inherited authorship and licenses are retained.
